response.sql: WITH budget_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) as total_cost, COUNT(*) as expense_count FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_per_budget AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) as avg_spend FROM budget_totals) SELECT AVG(bt.total_cost) as average_total, SUM(bt.expense_count) as total_expenses, AVG(bt.total_cost - apb.avg_spend) as avg_excess FROM budget_totals bt CROSS JOIN avg_per_budget apb WHERE bt.total_cost > apb.avg_spend
